author: Mathew Beall
releaseNotes:
v2.1.0: Water leak sensors (SWS51) now report wet/dry correctly, based on data from real hardware. New 'X-Sense Temperature/Humidity Sensor' child driver for STH0B/STH51 sensors (temperature in your hub's scale, humidity, alarm ranges). After updating, open the app and click 'Recreate Child Devices' so any temperature/humidity sensor that was created as a smoke detector gets the right driver.

v2.0.2: Skip an automatic poll if another poll ran in the last 30 seconds, so the first scheduled poll no longer doubles up with the post-setup refresh. Manual Refresh always runs.

v2.0.1: Remove the deprecated 1.x bridge driver from the package.

UPGRADING FROM 1.x: version 2.0 is an app, not a virtual device, so do not use HPM Update. Instead: (1) delete your old 'X-Sense Bridge' virtual device, which removes its child devices; (2) in HPM choose Uninstall and remove the old X-Sense package; (3) in HPM choose Install and install X-Sense Integration; (4) go to Apps > Add User App > X-Sense Integration, enter your X-Sense email and password, click Done; (5) re-point rules and HSM at the new child devices.

NEW INSTALL: after HPM finishes, go to Apps > Add User App > X-Sense Integration, enter your X-Sense email and password, and click Done. Devices are created automatically.

v2.0.0: Integration converted to an app with a setup/status page. Water leak sensor (SWS51) support, driver chosen by device type, Recreate Child Devices action, raw shadow logging option.
